fusions.name: Festering Graze
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance of [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Broken-Off Bud
fusions.desc: Snaps a spined growth from your tail and launches it, dealing 28 water damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles. It then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Encrust
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage for 10 seconds, and your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Overgrowth
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
